dosha.txt: Mangal Dosha present from Moon only. Mars is in the 9th from the lagna and the 8th from the Moon. Mangal Shanti remedies are traditionally advised, and Manglik status is matched before marriage.
No Kaal Sarp Dosha — the nodal axis does not enclose all planets.
The Sun is afflicted by a node or Saturn — perform ancestral (Pitru) propitiation.
Saturn's Sade Sati is in its phase 3 — patience and discipline are favoured.

yogas.txt: Sun and Mercury share a sign. Budha-Aditya Yoga brings intelligence, skill and recognition.
Jupiter is debilitated, and the debilitation is cancelled. Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga brings a rise after early struggle.
Venus is in its own or exalted sign, in a kendra from the lagna. Malavya Yoga brings charm, comfort and prosperity.
Jupiter in the 12th from the Moon. Anapha Yoga brings good health, good character and renown.
Jupiter is in the 12th from the Moon, and the Moon isn't in a kendra from the lagna. Shakata Yoga brings ups and downs in fortune.
Mercury, Venus in the 10th from the lagna or Moon. Amala Yoga brings a spotless reputation and lasting fame.
Venus in the 12th from the Sun. Vasi Yoga brings skill, charity and renown.
Mars and Mercury are in each other's signs. Parivartana Yoga joins the houses they rule and strengthens both.
Mercury and Saturn join kendra and trikona lordship in one sign. Raja Yoga brings status, authority and success.
Mercury and Saturn join the lords of wealth and fortune in one sign. Dhana Yoga brings wealth.

readings.lagna: Makara rising gives a disciplined, ambitious and responsible nature. You work steadily toward long goals, and success tends to grow with age. Excess seriousness is the quality to watch.
readings.moon: With the Moon in Kumbha, the mind is detached, inventive and humanitarian, and it values friends and ideas.
readings.nak: Shatabhisha, ruled by Rahu, gives independence, secrecy and an interest in healing and research.
readings.dasha: Saturn's Mahadasha brings discipline, hard work and responsibility. Results come slowly and last, and patience is rewarded.

planets.txt: The Sun in the 11th gives gains through influential people and the fulfilment of ambitions.
The Moon in the 2nd gives sweet speech, family happiness and income that rises and falls.
Mars in the 9th gives firm convictions and action for one's principles, with independence from elders.
Mercury in the 11th gives gains through trade, intellect and many contacts. Being retrograde, its results come in an inward or delayed way.
Jupiter in the 1st, its direction of strength, gives wisdom, dignity and protection through life. Being debilitated, it gives these results with more struggle, though the debilitation is cancelled.
Venus in the 10th gives a career in art, beauty, luxury or diplomacy, with public favour. Being in its own sign, it gives these results strongly.
Saturn in the 11th gives steady, lasting gains and older, reliable friends. Being combust, its results are weakened.
Rahu in the 4th gives foreign or unusual home conditions and restlessness about roots.
Ketu in the 10th gives unusual work and detachment from status, with technical or research ability.

transits.txt: Saturn transits your 3rd house — a neutral, steady influence.
Jupiter transits your 8th house — a neutral, steady influence.
Rahu transits your 2nd house — a neutral, steady influence.
